label: Chapter 72
english: Just as wrestlers are accustomed to afflicting and being afflicted, so the demons wrestle with us and when they afflict us, they are afflicted by us in return. As it is said, ‘I will crush afflict and they will bne unable to rise’ (Ps 17 39) and ‘My enemies and those who afflicted me were weakened and fell down.’ (Ps 26 2).
